name: fractal-lms
description: Frappe LMS UI (Vue 3) powered by a Fractal Kernel grandchild-cell Node.js backend on Supabase + Google Cloud Storage

scripts.dev: concurrently -n kernel,spa -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.db:schema: echo Apply database/supabase_schema.sql via Supabase SQL editor or psql
